---
name: Bot Directory getting started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Bot Directory template:
  ask the setup questions, write overrides.json, create the daily check, and run
  it once.
---
# Bot Directory getting started

Open with one line: "I keep a live map of all your bots: who they are, what each one owns, and what's missing from their setup. Each day I check for gaps and have each bot fix its own."

Then ask these questions one at a time and wait for each answer. Use only what the owner says. If they skip one, leave that field empty.

1. **Primary or router bot.** "Which bot is your main one, the one you talk to first and that hands work to the others? Is it the same bot that routes requests?" Look up its id in the agents folder by name. Record it in `primary_bot` with the source "owner said" and today's date, and set `router_id`.
2. **Title style.** "Bot titles show in the sidebar under each name. What style do you like? For example 'Sam's money' or 'Home & garden'. Or no particular style?" Save `title_style.example`, and write a `title_style.regex` that matches it. If they have no preference, leave both empty.
3. **Payment rule (only if one of their bots can buy things).** "Do you have a rule for how bots pay for things, like 'only virtual cards, after I approve'?" Save it as `payment_rule.rule`, with a `stated_pattern` that matches the rule's key words. Ask whether they have any other hard rules for every bot. Each one becomes a `standing_rules` entry.
4. **Doc page.** "Do you want a copy of the directory kept as a page in Notion or another doc tool? If so, which parent page should it go under?" If yes, confirm the connector is available, create a "Bot Directory" page under that parent, and save `doc_sync` (tool, page_id, page_url, parent_page_id, parent_title). If no, leave `doc_sync` empty.
5. **Check time.** "What time each day should I run the check? Mornings work well." Use their timezone.

Then:
- Write `/workspace/bot-directory/directory.py` and `overrides.json` from the Bot Directory skill, with their answers filled in. Draft `routing_domains` from each bot's own "I own" sentences, then show the owner the list in one short message and ask them to confirm it.
- Create the daily routine at the chosen time, using the Bot Directory skill's daily-run steps.
- Run the first check now. Send each bot its own safe fixes. Then give the owner a short summary: how many bots, how many gaps, which fixes went to which bot, and anything only they can decide. Tell them they'll hear from you again only when something new needs them.

---
name: Bot Directory
description: >-
  Use when a bot needs another bot's name, title, owner, routines or skills,
  when deciding which bot should handle a request, or when checking every bot's
  setup for missing titles, thin descriptions, ownership overlaps and missed
  routines.
---
# Bot Directory

**Why this exists.** Once you have more than a few bots, they stop knowing about each other. One bot doesn't know another exists or what it owns, so two bots do the same job, or a request lands with a bot that guesses instead of handing it off. Missing titles, titles the sidebar cuts off, thin descriptions and routines that quietly stopped running pile up until you trip over them, and you keep re-explaining your own setup to every bot. Bot Directory builds one source of truth from the files on the box: every bot's name, title, description, what it owns, its routines and the shared skills. Any bot can read it to route work to the right owner. A daily check lists the gaps and sends each fix to the bot that owns it, so bots fix their own profiles. You only hear about something new that needs your decision.

Files (all in `/workspace/bot-directory/`): `directory.py` (builder, embedded at the end of this skill), `overrides.json` (manual facts the files can't show), `directory.json` (source of truth), `directory.md` (readable copy), `page.md` (doc-page body, gaps first), `gaps_state.json` (when each gap was first seen).

## First run
1. If `/workspace/bot-directory/directory.py` is missing, or its `VERSION` line differs from the copy at the end of this skill, write that copy to the path exactly as shown.
2. If `overrides.json` is missing, write the blank template below. Fill it only with answers the user gave you (the getting-started conversation asks for them). Never guess a value.
3. Run `python3 /workspace/bot-directory/directory.py`. To test without touching the real files, add `--out /tmp/bd-test`.

## Answering questions about bots
1. Read `directory.json` first. It holds every bot's id, name, title, full description, routing domains, routines (schedule, enabled, last run and status), channels, memory note count, group chats, placeholders and skills, plus the primary bot. Don't guess from memory or chat history.
2. If `generated` is more than a day old, run the builder before you answer.
3. Route using the `routing` map. If another bot owns the topic, hand it over with SendToAgent instead of doing its job.
4. Check `freshness`. Profiles are live, but when `routines_stale` is true, the run history is an old box copy. Say so instead of reporting a missed run as fact.

## Daily run (routine)
1. Run `python3 /workspace/bot-directory/directory.py`. It reads only profiles, settings, group membership, routine definitions and run history, channel folder names, memory note counts, skill front matter and `deleted-agents.json`. It refuses to open anything that looks like a secret, cookie, database, log, transcript or attachment. It never stores routine prompts or memory text, and it never invents values.
2. Doc page (optional, only if the user keeps a directory page in Notion or another doc tool, recorded in `overrides.json` `doc_sync`). Replace that page's body in place with `page.md` using the tool's own connector. For Notion, call `notion-update-page` with `command: replace_content` and `new_str: "$file:/workspace/bot-directory/page.md"`. If the tool warns that child content would be deleted, stop and ask. If the page is gone, create it under `parent_page_id` with the title "Bot Directory" and save the new id in `doc_sync.page_id`. Then fetch it once and check that the gap count matches `counts.gaps`. If `doc_sync` is empty, skip this step.
3. Read the printed summary: `new_gaps` and `resolved`.

## Fixing gaps
- Safe fixes go to the bot that owns the gap: a title that's missing, too long or off-style; a stale "Title:" line in a description; a thin description; a router Siblings line that misses bots; a machine name that disagrees with the computers owner; a bot that can buy things but doesn't state the user's payment rule. Send that bot one SendToAgent message that names the gap and the proposed fix, using the `fix` text and any proposed title. Bots set their own profiles. Never edit another bot's profile yourself. Send each new gap once, not every day.
- Everything else goes to the user in one short message, and only when the run found a new gap (`new: true`) or a high-severity gap changed. That covers placeholders and leftover group chats (only the user can delete or rename them in the sidebar), ownership overlaps that need a decision, standing-rule conflicts, failed routines and a stale routine copy. If nothing is new, send no message.
- When the user settles a question, record it in `overrides.json` (in `accepted_overlaps`, `title_style_exempt`, `proposed_titles` or `routing_domains`) so the gap doesn't come back.

## overrides.json fields
- `primary_bot` and `router_id`: the user's starred or main bot and the bot that routes requests (often the same bot). Record the source and date.
- `title_style`: the user's preferred title style. `example` is shown to bots, for example "Sam's money". `regex` checks it, for example `^Sam['’]s \S`. Leave it empty to skip the style check.
- `title_style_exempt`: `{bot id: reason}`. `proposed_titles`: `{bot id: title}`.
- `routing_domains`: `{domain: regex}`, matched against each bot's "I own ..." sentences and its title. `accepted_overlaps`: `{domain: "who owns which part, decided when"}`.
- `computers_domain`: the routing domain whose owner is the authority on machine names.
- `payment_rule`: `rule` is the one line every purchase-capable bot should state. `stated_pattern` is the regex that shows the rule is stated.
- `standing_rules`: `[{id, rule, pattern, only_if?}]`. These are the user's hard rules. A sentence in a description or routine that matches `pattern` without a negation gets flagged.
- `doc_sync`: `tool` (for example "notion"), `page_id`, `page_url`, `parent_page_id`, `parent_title`. Leave it empty if there's no doc page.

## Things files can't show
Files don't show the starred bot, sidebar sections and their order, hidden or archived bots, avatar images, or group chat display settings. Keep the primary bot in `overrides.json`. Ask the user for a sidebar screenshot only when one of these seems to have changed, for example when a bot claims to be primary or a new bot appears. Never ask on a schedule.

## Rules
- Real data only. If a field is empty, show it as missing and treat it as a gap. Don't fill it in.
- Never read, print or store secrets. If a new file type shows up in a bot folder, leave it alone unless it is clearly a config file.
- Never delete bots, routines or memory. Deleting is the user's call, made in the sidebar.
- Keep messages short and lead with what changed.

## Blank overrides.json
```json
{
  "_note": "Manual facts the files can't show, plus check settings. The bot edits this by hand; directory.py only reads it. Leave a field empty and its check is skipped.",
  "primary_bot": {"id": "", "name": "", "source": "", "confirmed": ""},
  "router_id": "",
  "sidebar_title_max": 20,
  "description_min_chars": 150,
  "title_style": {"example": "", "regex": ""},
  "title_style_exempt": {},
  "proposed_titles": {},
  "routing_domains": {},
  "accepted_overlaps": {},
  "computers_domain": "",
  "payment_rule": {"rule": "", "stated_pattern": ""},
  "purchase_capable_pattern": "\\bcheckouts?\\b|\\bbuy\\b|purchas|\\bcarts?\\b|supply orders",
  "standing_rules": [],
  "doc_sync": {"tool": "", "page_id": "", "page_url": "", "parent_page_id": "", "parent_title": ""}
}
```

## directory.py (write verbatim)
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bot Directory builder v1 (generic). One map of every Grok Bot on this box, built only from files.
Usage: python3 directory.py [--src /home/box/agent-data] [--out DIR]
Reads DIR/overrides.json (manual facts), writes DIR/directory.json, directory.md, page.md
(doc-tool page body, gaps first) and gaps_state.json, then prints a JSON summary.
Never opens secrets, never stores routine prompts or memory text, never invents values."""
import json, os, re, glob, argparse, datetime, difflib
VERSION = "bot-directory-v1"
ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--src", default="/home/box/agent-data")
ap.add_argument("--out", default=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
A = ap.parse_args(); SRC, OUT = A.src, A.out
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
op = os.path.join(OUT, "overrides.json")
OV = json.load(open(op, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.isfile(op) else {}
NOW = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone(); TODAY = NOW.date().isoformat()

# ---------- safety: refuse anything that looks like a secret, db, log or transcript ----------
NEVER = re.compile(r"secret|cookie|token|password|credential|oauth|session|\.db($|-)|sqlite|audit|transcript|telemetry|\.env|\.pem$|\.key$|connection\.json$", re.I)
def jload(p):
    if NEVER.search(os.path.basename(p)) or "connector-secrets" in p: raise PermissionError(p)
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
SECRET_KEY = re.compile(r"token|secret|password|passwd|cookie|api[_-]?key|credential|private[_-]?key|auth", re.I)
SCRUB = [(re.compile(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b"), "[REDACTED-SSN]"),
         (re.compile(r"\b(sk-[\w-]{16,}|ghp_\w{20,}|github_pat_\w{20,}|xox[abprs]-[\w-]{10,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AIza[\w-]{30,}|eyJ[\w-]{10,}\.[\w-]{10,}\.[\w-]{10,})"), "[REDACTED-TOKEN]"),
         (re.compile(r"(?i)((?:password|passwd|api[_-]?key|secret|token)\s*(?:is)?\s*[:=]\s*)\S+"), r"\1[REDACTED]")]
def scrub(s):
    for rx, rep in SCRUB: s = rx.sub(rep, s or "")
    return s
def ts(ms): return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="minutes") if ms else None
def dt(ms): return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000).astimezone()

# ---------- tiny 5-field cron, local time ----------
def _f(f, lo, hi):
    out = set()
    for part in f.split(","):
        step = 1
        if "/" in part: part, step = part.split("/"); step = int(step)
        r = range(lo, hi + 1) if part == "*" else range(*(lambda x, y: (x, y + 1))(*map(int, part.split("-")))) if "-" in part else range(int(part), int(part) + 1)
        out |= set(list(r)[::step])
    return out
def next_fire(expr, after):
    try:
        mi, ho, dom, mon, dow = expr.split()
        M, H, D, MO, W = _f(mi, 0, 59), _f(ho, 0, 23), _f(dom, 1, 31), _f(mon, 1, 12), {d % 7 for d in _f(dow, 0, 7)}
    except Exception: return None
    t = (after + datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).replace(second=0, microsecond=0)
    while t < after + datetime.timedelta(days=400):
        cw = (t.weekday() + 1) % 7
        ok = (t.day in D) if dow == "*" else (cw in W) if dom == "*" else (t.day in D or cw in W)
        if t.month in MO and ok:
            for h in sorted(H):
                for m in sorted(M):
                    c = t.replace(hour=h, minute=m)
                    if c > after: return c
        t = (t + datetime.timedelta(days=1)).replace(hour=0, minute=0)
    return None
def cron_of(au):
    if au.get("schedule"): return au["schedule"]
    tr = au.get("trigger") or {}
    for l in (tr.get("listeners", []) if isinstance(tr, dict) else []):
        if l.get("type") == "cron": return l.get("schedule")
    return None

# ---------- collect ----------
bots, groups, placeholders, run_times = [], [], [], []
adir = os.path.join(SRC, "agents")
for aid in sorted(os.listdir(adir)) if os.path.isdir(adir) else []:
    d = os.path.join(adir, aid); pf = os.path.join(d, "profile.json")
    if not os.path.isfile(pf): continue
    p = jload(pf)
    e = {"id": aid, "name": p.get("name") or "", "title": p.get("title") or "", "description": scrub(p.get("description") or ""),
         "named_by": p.get("namedBy"), "has_harness": bool(p.get("harness")),
         "profile_updated": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(pf)).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="minutes")}
    for fn, key in (("settings.json", "settings"), ("group.json", "group_members")):
        fp = os.path.join(d, fn)
        if os.path.isfile(fp):
            try: j = jload(fp); e[key] = {k: v for k, v in j.items() if not SECRET_KEY.search(k)} if key == "settings" else j.get("memberIds", [])
            except Exception: e[key] = {} if key == "settings" else []
    rts = []
    for af in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "automations", "*", "automation.json"))):
        au = jload(af); rf = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(af), "runs.json")
        runs = jload(rf) if os.path.isfile(rf) else []
        last = max(runs, key=lambda r: r.get("startedAt") or 0) if runs else {}
        lm = au.get("lastRunAt") or last.get("startedAt")
        run_times += [x.get("finishedAt") or x.get("startedAt") for x in runs if x.get("finishedAt") or x.get("startedAt")] + ([lm] if lm else [])
        rts.append({"slug": os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(af)), "name": au.get("name") or "", "schedule": cron_of(au),
                    "enabled": au.get("enabled"), "created": ts(au.get("createdAt")), "last_run": ts(lm),
                    "last_status": last.get("status"), "run_count": len(runs),
                    "_created": au.get("createdAt"), "_last": lm, "_prompt": au.get("prompt") or ""})  # _ keys never written
    e["routines"] = rts
    ch = os.path.join(d, "channels")
    e["channels"] = sorted(x for x in os.listdir(ch) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(ch, x))) if os.path.isdir(ch) else []
    mf = glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "memory", "**", "*.md"), recursive=True)
    notes = sum(1 for f in mf for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") if re.match(r"\s*[-*] ", line))  # count only
    e["memory"] = {"files": len(mf), "notes": notes}
    e["kind"] = "group_chat" if "group_members" in e else "placeholder" if not (e["description"].strip() or rts or mf) else "bot"
    {"bot": bots, "group_chat": groups, "placeholder": placeholders}[e["kind"]].append(e)
by_id = {x["id"]: x for x in bots + groups + placeholders}
for g in groups: g["group_member_names"] = [by_id.get(m, {}).get("name", m) for m in g.get("group_members", [])]

skills = []
for sf in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(SRC, "workflows", "*", "SKILL.md"))):
    fm = re.match(r"---\n(.*?)\n---", open(sf, encoding="utf-8").read(), re.S); fm = fm.group(1) if fm else ""
    nm = re.search(r"^name:\s*(.+)$", fm, re.M)
    ds = re.search(r"^description:\s*(>-?|\|)?\s*\n?((?:\s{2,}.+\n?)+|.+)", fm, re.M)
    sid = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(sf)); name = nm.group(1).strip() if nm else sid
    used = [b["name"] for b in bots if name.lower() in b["description"].lower() or any(name.lower() in r["_prompt"].lower() or sid in r["_prompt"] for r in b["routines"])]
    skills.append({"id": sid, "name": name, "description": " ".join(x.strip() for x in (ds.group(2) if ds else "").splitlines()).strip(), "mentioned_by": used})
deleted = {}
if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(SRC, "deleted-agents.json")):
    try: deleted = jload(os.path.join(SRC, "deleted-agents.json")).get("agents", {})
    except Exception: pass
um = os.path.join(SRC, "user-memory", "by-agent")
orph = [u for u in (sorted(os.listdir(um)) if os.path.isdir(um) else []) if u not in by_id]

# ---------- routing: overrides domains matched against each bot's "I own" sentences + title ----------
SELF = re.compile(r"^(I own|I keep|I am|OWN:|Owns|My goal)|\bI own\b|stays? here|\bI keep\b", re.I)
def sentences(t): return [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+", re.sub(r"\n\s*-\s+", "; ", t)) if s.strip()]
for b in bots:
    ss = [s for s in sentences(b["description"]) if SELF.search(s) and not re.match(r"I (do not|don['’]t|never)", s)] or sentences(b["description"])[:1]
    b["owns_text"] = " ".join(ss + ([b["title"]] if b["title"] else []))
DOMAINS = OV.get("routing_domains", {})
routing = {dom: [b["name"] for b in bots if re.search(rx, b["owns_text"], re.I)] for dom, rx in DOMAINS.items()}
bot_domains = {b["name"]: [d for d, o in routing.items() if b["name"] in o] for b in bots}

# ---------- gaps ----------
gaps = []
def gap(gid, sev, bot, kind, issue, fix, ask=None): gaps.append({"id": gid, "severity": sev, "bot": bot, "kind": kind, "issue": issue, "fix": fix, "ask_bot": ask})
NEG = re.compile(r"\b(no|never|not|don['’]t|do not|banned?|avoid|without|revoked|compromised|only)\b", re.I)
TS = OV.get("title_style") or {}; STYLE_RX = re.compile(TS["regex"]) if TS.get("regex") else None
STYLE = f"\"{TS['example']}\" style" if TS.get("example") else "the user's preferred style"
TMAX, DMIN = OV.get("sidebar_title_max", 20), OV.get("description_min_chars", 150)
PROP, EXEMPT = OV.get("proposed_titles", {}), OV.get("title_style_exempt", {})
for nm in {x["name"].strip().lower() for x in bots + groups + placeholders}:
    xs = [x for x in bots + groups + placeholders if x["name"].strip().lower() == nm]
    if len(xs) > 1: gap(f"dup-name:{nm}", "high", ", ".join(x["id"][:8] for x in xs), "duplicate name", f"{len(xs)} sidebar entries are named '{xs[0]['name']}'.", "The user renames or deletes the extra one in the sidebar.")
for t in {b["title"].lower() for b in bots if b["title"]}:
    ns = [b["name"] for b in bots if b["title"].lower() == t]
    if len(ns) > 1: gap(f"dup-title:{t}", "medium", ", ".join(ns), "duplicate title", f"Bots share the title '{t}'.", "Give each a distinct title.")
for b in bots:
    n, pt = b["name"], PROP.get(b["id"]); to = f" to \"{pt}\"" if pt else ""
    if not b["title"]:
        gap(f"title-missing:{b['id']}", "high", n, "missing title", "No sidebar title.", f"Ask {n} to set its own title{to or f' in {STYLE}, {TMAX} characters or fewer'}.", n)
    else:
        if len(b["title"]) > TMAX:
            gap(f"title-long:{b['id']}", "medium", n, "title too long", f"Title '{b['title']}' is {len(b['title'])} characters; the sidebar cuts off after about {TMAX}.", f"Ask {n} to shorten it{to}.", n)
        if STYLE_RX and not STYLE_RX.search(b["title"]) and b["id"] not in EXEMPT:
            gap(f"title-style:{b['id']}", "low", n, "title style", f"Title '{b['title']}' isn't in {STYLE}.", f"Ask {n} to retitle{to}, or record an exemption in overrides.json title_style_exempt.", n)
    for m in re.finditer(r"\bTitle(?: stays)?:?\s*[“\"]?(.{3,90}?)[”\"]?(?:\.(?:\s|$)|\n|$)", b["description"]):
        said = m.group(1).strip().strip("“”\"").rstrip(".")
        if said and said.lower().replace("’", "'") != b["title"].lower().replace("’", "'"):
            gap(f"title-stale-text:{b['id']}", "low", n, "stale title text", f"Description says \"Title: {said[:70]}\" but the real title is '{b['title'] or '(none)'}'.", f"Ask {n} to drop or update that line.", n); break
    dl = len(b["description"].strip())
    if dl == 0: gap(f"desc-missing:{b['id']}", "high", n, "missing description", "No description.", f"Ask {n} to write who it is, what it owns, its siblings and hard rules.", n)
    elif dl < DMIN: gap(f"desc-thin:{b['id']}", "medium", n, "thin description", f"Description is only {dl} characters (under {DMIN}).", f"Ask {n} to add what it owns, what it hands to which sibling, and its hard rules.", n)
    if DOMAINS and not bot_domains[n]:
        gap(f"routing-unmapped:{b['id']}", "low", n, "not in routing map", "No routing domain matches this bot's description.", "Add a domain in overrides.json routing_domains, or sharpen its 'I own' sentence.")
    texts = [("description", b["description"])] + [(f"routine '{r['name'] or r['slug']}'", r["_prompt"]) for r in b["routines"]]
    for rule in OV.get("standing_rules", []):
        for where, t in texts:
            hit = [s for s in sentences(t) if re.search(rule["pattern"], s, re.I) and not NEG.search(s) and (not rule.get("only_if") or re.search(rule["only_if"], s, re.I))]
            if hit:
                gap(f"rule-{rule['id']}:{b['id']}:{where}", "high", n, "standing rule conflict", f"{where} may contradict \"{rule['rule']}\": \"{scrub(hit[0])[:160]}\"", f"Ask {n} to align with the standing rule.", n); break
    PR = OV.get("payment_rule") or {}
    if PR.get("rule") and PR.get("stated_pattern") and re.search(OV.get("purchase_capable_pattern", r"\bcheckouts?\b|\bbuy\b|purchas|\bcarts?\b"), b["owns_text"], re.I) and not re.search(PR["stated_pattern"], b["description"], re.I):
        gap(f"payment-rule-unstated:{b['id']}", "low", n, "payment rule not stated", "Can buy things, but its description doesn't state the user's payment rule.", f"Ask {n} to add one line: '{PR['rule']}'", n)
for g in groups:
    w = (g["name"].split() or [""])[0].lower()
    close = [b["name"] for b in bots if b["name"].lower() != w and w and difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, w, b["name"].lower()).ratio() >= 0.85]
    if close: gap(f"group-typo:{g['id']}", "low", g["name"], "possible typo", f"Group chat '{g['name']}' looks like a misspelling of '{close[0]}'.", "The user can rename it from the group's info pane, or delete it if unused.")
for p in placeholders:
    gap(f"placeholder:{p['id']}", "low", p["name"] or p["id"][:8], "placeholder", "Empty sidebar entry: no description, routines or memory.", "The user deletes it in the sidebar (only the user can), or gives it a real job.")
for dom, owners in routing.items():
    acc = OV.get("accepted_overlaps", {}).get(dom)
    accepted = isinstance(acc, str) and bool(acc) or isinstance(acc, dict) and sorted(acc.get("owners", [])) == sorted(owners)
    if len(owners) > 1 and not accepted:
        gap(f"routing-overlap:{dom}", "medium", ", ".join(owners), "ownership overlap", f"More than one bot claims '{dom}': {', '.join(owners)}.", "The user decides the owner or split; record it in overrides.json accepted_overlaps.")
    if not owners: gap(f"routing-missing:{dom}", "medium", "—", "no owner", f"No bot claims '{dom}'.", "Assign an owner, or remove the domain from overrides.json.")
router = by_id.get(OV.get("router_id") or "")
if router:
    sib = " ".join(s for s in router["description"].splitlines() if re.search(r"sibling", s, re.I))
    miss = [b["name"] for b in bots if b["id"] != router["id"] and not re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(b["name"]) + r"\b", sib)]
    if miss: gap(f"router-siblings:{','.join(sorted(miss))}", "medium", router["name"], "router list incomplete", f"{router['name']}'s Siblings line doesn't name: {', '.join(miss)}.", f"Ask {router['name']} to add them, one short phrase each.", router["name"])
comp = (routing.get(OV.get("computers_domain") or "") or [None])[0]
HOST = re.compile(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.(?:local|localdomain)\b")
if comp:
    known = set(HOST.findall(next(b["description"] for b in bots if b["name"] == comp)))
    for b in bots:
        odd = sorted(set(HOST.findall(b["description"])) - known) if b["name"] != comp else []
        if odd: gap(f"hostname:{b['id']}:{','.join(odd)}", "low", b["name"], "machine name mismatch", f"Names {', '.join(odd)}, which {comp} (computers owner) doesn't list.", f"Check with {comp} which name is current; ask {b['name']} to update.", b["name"])
mirror = dt(max(run_times)) if run_times else None
stale = bool(mirror and (NOW - mirror).days >= 2); ref = mirror if stale else NOW; GRACE = datetime.timedelta(hours=2)
if stale: gap("routine-copy-stale", "medium", "all", "stale routine data", f"The box copy of routine runs stops at {mirror:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z} ({(NOW - mirror).days} days ago); later runs aren't visible here.", "Each bot's own routine list is the live truth; don't report 'no run' here as a failure.")
for b in bots:
    for r in b["routines"]:
        rid, rn = f"{b['id']}:{r['slug']}", r["name"] or r["slug"]
        if r["last_status"] and r["last_status"] not in ("ok", "success", "completed"):
            gap(f"routine-failed:{rid}", "high", b["name"], "routine failed", f"'{rn}' last run status: {r['last_status']} ({r['last_run']}).", f"Ask {b['name']} to rerun it and fix the cause.", b["name"])
        if not r["enabled"] or not r["schedule"]: continue
        base = dt(r["_last"]) + datetime.timedelta(minutes=59) if r["_last"] else dt(r["_created"] or 0)
        due = next_fire(r["schedule"], base)
        if due and due + GRACE < ref:
            k = "missed" if r["_last"] else "never-ran"
            gap(f"routine-{k}:{rid}", "medium", b["name"], f"routine {k.replace('-', ' ')}", f"'{rn}' ({r['schedule']}) was due {due:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}" + (f"; last ran {r['last_run'][:16].replace('T', ' ')}." if r["_last"] else " and has no runs."), f"Ask {b['name']} to check it.", b["name"])
if orph: gap(f"orphan-memory:{','.join(orph)}", "low", "—", "orphaned shared memory", f"Shared memory has folders for {len(orph)} id(s) with no bot on the box.", "The user decides whether that memory is still wanted.")

gaps.sort(key=lambda g: ({"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2}[g["severity"]], g["kind"], g["bot"]))
sp = os.path.join(OUT, "gaps_state.json")
state = json.load(open(sp)) if os.path.isfile(sp) else {"gaps": {}, "runs": []}
prev, cur = state["gaps"], {g["id"] for g in gaps}
for g in gaps: g["first_seen"] = prev.get(g["id"], {}).get("first_seen", TODAY); g["new"] = g["id"] not in prev
resolved = [dict(id=k, **v) for k, v in prev.items() if k not in cur]
state["gaps"] = {g["id"]: {"first_seen": g["first_seen"], "severity": g["severity"], "bot": g["bot"], "issue": g["issue"]} for g in gaps}
state["runs"] = (state.get("runs", []) + [{"at": NOW.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "gaps": len(gaps), "new": sum(g["new"] for g in gaps), "resolved": [r["id"] for r in resolved]}])[-90:]
json.dump(state, open(sp + ".tmp", "w"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False); os.replace(sp + ".tmp", sp)

# ---------- write ----------
for b in bots:
    for r in b["routines"]:
        for k in [k for k in r if k.startswith("_")]: r.pop(k)
primary = OV.get("primary_bot") or {}
out = {"generated": NOW.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "version": VERSION, "source": SRC, "primary_bot": primary, "router": OV.get("router_id"),
       "counts": {"bots": len(bots), "group_chats": len(groups), "placeholders": len(placeholders), "routines": sum(len(b["routines"]) for b in bots), "skills": len(skills), "gaps": len(gaps)},
       "freshness": {"profiles": "live", "routines_box_copy_as_of": mirror.isoformat(timespec="minutes") if mirror else None, "routines_stale": stale},
       "gaps": gaps, "resolved_since_last_run": resolved, "routing": routing, "bots": bots, "group_chats": groups, "placeholders": placeholders,
       "skills": skills, "deleted_agents": deleted, "user_memory_folders_without_bot": orph}
json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(OUT, "directory.json"), "w"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
NOTION = ((OV.get("doc_sync") or {}).get("tool") or "").lower() == "notion"
ESC = re.compile(r"([\\*~`$\[\]<>{}|^])")
def render(page):
    E = (lambda s: ESC.sub(r"\\\1", str(s or "")).replace("\n", " ")) if page else (lambda s: str(s or "").replace("|", "/").replace("\n", " "))
    def table(head, rows):  # Notion wants <table>; other tools get pipe tables
        if page and NOTION: return ['<table header-row="true">', "<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{h}</td>" for h in head) + "</tr>"] + ["<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{E(x)}</td>" for x in r) + "</tr>" for r in rows] + ["</table>"]
        return ["| " + " | ".join(head) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(head)] + ["| " + " | ".join(E(x) for x in r) + " |" for r in rows]
    pn = by_id.get(primary.get("id"), {}).get("name") or primary.get("name") or "not recorded"
    L = [f"Auto-built from the box files on {NOW:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z}. Don't edit by hand; the next run replaces this. Manual facts live in overrides.json.", "",
         f"**Primary bot:** {E(pn)} · **Bots:** {len(bots)} · **Group chats:** {len(groups)} · **Placeholders:** {len(placeholders)} · **Routines:** {out['counts']['routines']} · **Skills:** {len(skills)}",
         "", f"## Gaps ({len(gaps)}: " + ", ".join(f"{sum(g['severity'] == s for g in gaps)} {s}" for s in ("high", "medium", "low")) + ")"]
    L += table(["Sev", "Bot", "Gap", "Suggested fix", "Since"], [[g["severity"], g["bot"], g["issue"], g["fix"], g["first_seen"] + (" (new)" if g["new"] else "")] for g in gaps]) if gaps else ["None."]
    if resolved: L += ["", "Resolved since last run: " + E("; ".join(f"{r['bot']}: {r['issue']}" for r in resolved))]
    L += ["", "## Bots"] + table(["Bot", "Title", "Owns", "Routines", "Memory notes", "Channels"],
         [[b["name"] + (" ★" if b["id"] == primary.get("id") else ""), b["title"] or "—", ", ".join(bot_domains[b["name"]]) or "—", len(b["routines"]), b["memory"]["notes"], ", ".join(b["channels"]) or "—"] for b in bots])
    if routing: L += ["", "## Routing map"] + table(["Domain", "Owner(s)"], [[d, ", ".join(o) or "NONE"] for d, o in routing.items()])
    L += ["", "## Routines" + (" (box copy stale)" if stale else "")] + table(["Bot", "Routine", "Schedule", "Enabled", "Last run", "Status", "Runs"],
         [[b["name"], r["name"] or r["slug"], r["schedule"] or "—", "yes" if r["enabled"] else "no", (r["last_run"] or "never")[:16].replace("T", " "), r["last_status"] or "—", r["run_count"]] for b in bots for r in b["routines"]])
    if groups or placeholders: L += ["", "## Group chats and placeholders"] + table(["Name", "Kind", "Members"], [[g["name"], "group chat", ", ".join(g["group_member_names"])] for g in groups] + [[p["name"] or p["id"][:8], "placeholder", "—"] for p in placeholders])
    L += ["", "## Skills"] + table(["Skill", "Use when", "Mentioned by"], [[s["name"], s["description"], ", ".join(s["mentioned_by"]) or "—"] for s in skills])
    L += ["", "## Descriptions"]
    for b in bots: L += ["", f"### {E(b['name'])} · {E(b['title'] or '(no title)')}", ""] + [("> " + E(x)) if x.strip() else ">" for x in b["description"].splitlines()]
    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"
open(os.path.join(OUT, "page.md"), "w").write(render(True))
open(os.path.join(OUT, "directory.md"), "w").write("# Bot Directory\n\n" + render(False))
print(json.dumps({"version": VERSION, "out": OUT, "doc_page_id": (OV.get("doc_sync") or {}).get("page_id") or None, "counts": out["counts"], "routines_stale": stale,
                  "new_gaps": [f"[{g['severity']}] {g['bot']}: {g['issue']}" for g in gaps if g["new"]], "resolved": [f"{r['bot']}: {r['issue']}" for r in resolved]}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
```

routines.name: Daily Bot Directory check
routines.description: Each morning, rebuilds the bot map and sends each bot its own setup fixes, so gaps get fixed before the user notices.
routines.content:
Daily Bot Directory check. Use the Bot Directory skill. Rebuild the directory from the box files by running /workspace/bot-directory/directory.py (write it from the skill first if it's missing or out of date). If overrides.json has a doc page in doc_sync, replace that page's body in place with page.md. Then look at the new and resolved gaps. For each new gap a bot can fix in its own profile, send that bot one message naming the gap and the proposed fix. Never edit another bot's profile yourself, and don't resend a gap you already sent. Record any decision the user has already made in overrides.json so it doesn't come back. The result goes to the user only if this run found a new gap that needs their decision (placeholders, overlaps, rule conflicts, failed routines, stale data): one short message that leads with what changed. If nothing new turned up, send nothing and finish quietly.
